official_definition: By sending one core from any of your "Homura Toshiie" Grandwalker Nexus to this Spirit, during this turn, this Spirit's "Destruction Effect" can only be prevented Heavy Armor/Ultra Heavy Armor, and effects of the targets destroyed by this Spirit's effect can't activate. Then, you can destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with 10000 BP or more, or no 20px on it.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Flame Unleash] or [Flame Unleash: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Flame Unleash]", "give [Flame Unleash]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
